meta.role: The Shōsai design system's tokens: the design target for the first release (RFD 4), documented in docs/design-system.md and rendered by the development viewer in docs/design-system/. The applications still render from assets/theme/tokens.json; moving them onto these values is MVP implementation work.
meta.generated: docs/design-system/tokens.css, by scripts/generate-design-system-css.py (check with --check). Do not edit the CSS by hand.
meta.decided: 2026-10-14: accent stays the app slate (#4d5e86); ink-muted darkens to #625F57 for 4.5:1 on every chrome ground; phones in portrait show one page. 2026-10-20: the Bookshelf look, D1 paper: a sidebar with the open books replaces the tab strip and collapses to an icon rail while reading; the library is a warm shelf of covers under a Continue reading hero; chrome (#ece5d6) is a shade deeper than canvas (#f6f1e6); book, screen and panel titles in the editorial serif; layered shadows and a lit reading stage. 2026-10-21: the mark is 丸に書, the character 書 in Noto Serif JP Black inside a ring, navy on light grounds and cream on dark, and the app icon sets it on cream; the type set is Inter + Literata (Noto Sans JP + Shippori Mincho for Japanese), with five other pairings offered as a Typeface setting.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Window ground: the library and the space around panels. Lighter than chrome, so the sidebar reads as the room’s wall.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised controls and cards: toolbar, selected tab, note cards, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The centre of the reading stage, the progress track, skeletons and the foot of the shelf edge.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The lit centre of the reading stage; the radial gradient runs from here to stage-edge.

tokens.name: stage-edge
tokens.usage: The rim of the reading stage: sh-stage fades from stage at the centre to this, so pages sit in a lit field.

tokens.name: shelf
tokens.usage: The shelf edge under the library’s covers: a thin band from line through shelf to surface-sunken, with a soft shadow below.

tokens.name: control-raised
tokens.usage: The chosen option of a segmented control, raised off surface-sunken. Lighter than surface in dark so the choice still reads.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The sidebar and rail, the reader toolbar and status line, the notes panel and sheets: a shade deeper than canvas.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for quiet buttons, rows and unselected tabs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen (inputs, secondary buttons): 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, chrome and tabstrip.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: locations, metadata, captions, placeholders. Holds 4.5:1 on canvas, chrome and tabstrip. Darker than the repo's app.textMuted #726F67, which falls to 3.9:1 on the tab strip.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Shōsai slate: primary buttons, selection state, links in chrome, focus ring, progress fill. Text-safe on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected quiet controls (Notes toggled on, current scope). Pair with on-accent-soft text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Floating capsules over the page: back pill, selection toolbar, toasts. Dark in both app themes so it stands off any page theme, with shadow-menu for night pages.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Brand red from the app icon's spine. Only for the reader's own marks: the bookmark ribbon, the current-position tick, the wordmark. Never for errors.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed states (book finished, import done). Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Icons and fills for cautions. 4.1:1 on surface in light, so warning text is set in ink beside a warning icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert ground; text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal search, sheets and slide-over panels.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The 書 mark and the app icon’s character. Generated covers, marketing and the library’s empty state otherwise.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: Cover art and marketing only.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: App-icon ground and the mark on dark grounds. Cover art and marketing otherwise.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: A hairline accent in cover art only; never text.

tokens.name: brand-mark
tokens.usage: The 書 mark in the interface (sh-mark): ring and character in one colour, navy on light chrome and cream on dark. Nothing else.

tokens.name: page-paper
tokens.usage: Paper reading theme: page ground for EPUB and PDF.

tokens.name: page-paper-ink
tokens.usage: Paper theme book text.

tokens.name: page-paper-link
tokens.usage: Paper theme references and links inside the book.

tokens.name: page-sepia
tokens.usage: Sepia reading theme page ground.

tokens.name: page-sepia-ink
tokens.usage: Sepia theme book text.

tokens.name: page-sepia-link
tokens.usage: Sepia theme references and links.

tokens.name: page-night
tokens.usage: Night reading theme page ground. PDF pages are luminance-inverted onto it.

tokens.name: page-night-ink
tokens.usage: Night theme book text.

tokens.name: page-night-link
tokens.usage: Night theme references and links.

tokens.name: hl-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlight fill, yellow (the default). Drawn under text in every page theme.

tokens.name: hl-green
tokens.usage: Highlight fill, green.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Highlight fill, blue.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Highlight fill, pink.

tokens.name: hl-purple
tokens.usage: Highlight fill, purple.

tokens.name: swatch-yellow
tokens.usage: Solid yellow for the highlight swatch and the note-card dot.

tokens.name: swatch-green
tokens.usage: Solid green swatch and dot.

tokens.name: swatch-blue
tokens.usage: Solid blue swatch and dot.

tokens.name: swatch-pink
tokens.usage: Solid pink swatch and dot.

tokens.name: swatch-purple
tokens.usage: Solid purple swatch and dot.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Live text selection while dragging, before a color is chosen.

tokens.name: search-hit
tokens.usage: Every search match on the page, in every page theme.

tokens.name: search-current
tokens.usage: The focused search match, painted over search-hit.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Matched words in search results and note lists, in the app's chrome. Text on it stays ink. Pages use search-hit instead, because page themes do not follow the app theme.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Fig. 1 is the model every later section refers back to.
styles.usage: Note text, search results, settings copy.

styles.name: ui-control
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, menu items; sidebar entries at 14/18.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and the peek kicker. Latin only; Japanese labels use ui-caption.

styles.name: ed-display
styles.usage: The library title and other screen titles on desktop and tablet (34/38 on tablet, 30/34 on phone).

styles.name: ed-wordmark
styles.usage: The Shōsai wordmark beside the 書 mark. The bundled Noto Serif JP subset covers 書 (U+66F8) only.

styles.name: ed-quote
styles.usage: Quoted book text inside notes, peeks and search results, where the words are the book's, not the app's.

styles.name: ed-title
styles.usage: A book’s title wherever it names a book: the sidebar’s Reading now list (13/17), the reader toolbar (17/21), library cards, note and search meta. Never a control label.

styles.name: ed-section
styles.usage: Section heads on the library (All books) and panel titles (Notes, Contents, at 20/24).

styles.name: book-body
styles.sample: When on board H.M.S. ‘Beagle,’ as naturalist, I was much struck with certain facts.
styles.usage: Default EPUB body when the book sets no font. The reader's text-size control scales it from 70% to 160%.

styles.name: book-body-ja
styles.sample: 吾輩は猫である。名前はまだ無い。
styles.usage: Default Japanese body, horizontal or vertical.

styles.name: book-chapter
styles.usage: Fallback chapter label when the book's CSS gives none.

styles.name: book-folio
styles.usage: Folios and running heads, at 60% of the page ink.

sets.usage: The Typeface setting. Each set fills the ui role with its sans and the editorial and book roles with its serif; the Japanese faces back the Latin ones. The default set is bundled; the others are added when the setting ships.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls in a bar, note card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, panel side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Sheet padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Stage padding around a spread; section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Library gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins inside a reflowed page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Pages, progress bars, highlight corners, covers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges (repo radius.small).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the peek, the search palette (repo radius.medium).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; capsule ends come from height, not this token.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: A page or spread on the stage.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Book covers in the library (repo app.shadow.cover).

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Popovers and the floating capsules (repo app.shadow.menu).

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: The peek, search palette, dialogs and sheets (repo app.shadow.modal).

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A hairline lift for the selected sidebar entry, note cards and the Continue reading hero: a card a millimetre off the paper.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs with a pointer (desktop).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch layouts (tablet, phone).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The library sidebar on desktop; 220px on tablet.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The icon rail the sidebar collapses to while reading; 56px on tablet.

tokens.name: bottomnav-height
tokens.usage: The phone’s bottom bar: Library, Notes, Bookmarks, Search.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: The reader toolbar, on every layout.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: The location and progress line under the stage.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Docked notes panel on desktop; slide-over width on tablet is 360px.

tokens.name: spread-min-width
tokens.usage: Below this stage width the reader shows one page (repo layout.reader.spreadMinWidth).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of a reflowed page, in the book font's em.
